svg.aria-label: Receive, view and act on e-invoices
svg.title: Receive, view and act on e-invoices
svg.desc: One presentation overview with five action frames: automatic inbound receiving, business-level sent/received invoice list, one selected invoice, optional attachment download, and review and take action. Download and review branch separately from the opened invoice. Exact document types and status codes are in linked source tables. Available safe inbound data feeds consultation before ERP delivery is complete. Query and Retrieve show ERP-to-E-Invoice-Service communication; file bytes come from following the selected file URL.
